text:
Marta R.: FYI: prod-eu edge pods (asg-eu-ml) went into ReadinessProbeFailed after the 03:12 deploy, failing to hit nodeport /health — connection refused to 10.142.8.11:8080

Ryan K.: seeing the same, reproduced locally with kubectl port-forward and curl -> connection refused. No obvious pod-level crash.

Chen L.: can you paste the Service + Ingress snippets? any recent SG/NACL changes? :thinking_face:

Marta R.: here are the relevant pieces:
```
kubectl get svc edge-model -o yaml
# externalTrafficPolicy: Local
# annotations:
# alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internet-facing
# alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
# service.spec.externalTrafficPolicy: Local
```
Ingress annotation on ALB shows security-group: sg-0a1b2c-oldenv (old staging SG)

Ryan K.: wait, ALB is referencing sg-0a1b2c-oldenv? that SG is non-prod. If the ALB is attached to ENIs tagged wrong it'll pick the wrong SG and block traffic to nodeports.

Amanda S.: running a quick inventory: `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod` returned some ENIs where Tag env=staging (legacy). Looks like a cleanup missed a few.

deploy-bot: automatic rollback executed for asg-eu-ml at 03:20 UTC (reason: readiness failures)

Chen L.: short mitigation options: 1) update ALB SG to include correct rules for nodeport health (wider open to ALB subnets) 2) fix ENI tags so ALB picks the right SG 3) temporary NACL allow for 8080 from ALB subnets.

Ryan K.: I added an inbound NACL rule for the affected subnet group to permit tcp:8080 from the ALB subnets (10.20.0.0/22, 10.20.4.0/22) as a stopgap, and updated the instance SG to include sg-prod-alb.

Marta R.: after the NACL + SG change pods became Ready within two minutes. Readiness checks passing :tada:

Amanda S.: created INFRA-4722 to scrub ENI tags and reconcile SG references in infra state. Also added a terraform guard to prevent attaching sg-*-staging to production ALBs.

Chen L.: i'll add a pre-deploy validation in the pipeline to check ALB->ENI tag consistency and that ALB security groups are from the expected env namespace. Low-risk patch coming up.

Ryan K.: TL;DR for postmortem: cause = ALB ended up attached to ENIs with stale env tags -> ALB used a staging SG that didn't allow nodeport health traffic to prod nodes -> ingress to nodeports blocked. Fixes: correct SG on ALB/ENIs, temporary NACL allow, add infra guardrails and deploy-time checks.

Marta R.: thanks all. please add any follow-ups to INFRA-4722. Also follow-up action: run a sweep to find any other ALBs referencing sg-*-staging across prod accounts.

Amanda S.: on it, will run a cross-account query and post results in #eng-infra tomorrow. :mag:

Chen L.: recommend we also add a monitoring alert for ALBs with SGs that don't match the account ENV tag. low-noise rule but caught this earlier.

Ryan K.: agreed. I'll sketch an alert and a small lambda to verify SG<->tag mapping.

Marta R.: cool, closing this thread. thanks for the quick turnarounds.
